lines.t: Neon rivers on the floor, I’m walking through Your call
Echoes in the humming light, I hear You over all
You say, “Beloved, come to Me, let every burden fall”
In this glowing, endless night, Your whisper shakes the wall
Every color crashing like a storm inside my chest
You break the pride within my bones and pull me into rest
Love has saved them, love has saved me
From the shadow and the hunger and the craving to be free
Love has saved them, love has saved me
In the fire of Your presence where the blind begin to see
I walked the halls of empty gold, the fame that couldn’t stay
A poisoned tree of vanity that led my heart astray
But You cut down the branches where my ego used to sway
Now Your light is flooding in, it turns my night to day
Those who thought they stood so tall are falling at Your feet
Those forgotten in the dark are rising in Your heat
Love has saved them, love has saved me
From the kingdom of pretending and the chains of “look at me”
Love has saved them, love has saved me
Now the last are lifted higher in a brighter gravity
Those who were full shall be emptied,
So they can taste the feast You pour out endlessly
Those who were last shall be carried,
First in the glow of Your mercy, finally free
Those with no name shall be honored,
Clothed in a color no darkness can erase
Those with great knowledge fall silent,
Lost in the wonder of Your all-consuming grace
Neon thunder in my veins, heartbeat like a drum
You erase the bitter past, singing, “Child, come”
Every wound is washed in light beneath this holy dome
In the center of the storm, Your heart becomes my home
Love has saved them, love has saved me
From the echo of the grave and the fear of what I’ve been
Love has saved them, love has saved me
In this swirling, living temple where Your glory rushes in
So let the neon heavens ring, let every color cry
Mercy like an endless wave is pouring from the sky
Love has saved them, love has saved me, and this is why we sing
In the radiance of Your truth, forever glowing king
